description: Enter messages into the system log.

option.name: --file
tip: Log the contents of this file.

option.name: --help
tip: Display this help.

option.name: --id
tip: Log the given <id>, or otherwise the PID.

option.name: --journald
tip: Write journald entry.

option.name: --msgid
tip: Set rfc5424 message id field.

option.name: --no-act
tip: Do everything except write the log.

option.name: --octet-count
tip: Use rfc6587 octet counting.

option.name: --port
tip: Use this port for UDP or TCP connection.

option.name: --prio-prefix
tip: Look for a prefix on every line read from stdin.

option.name: --priority
tip: Mark given message with this priority.
For example user.info.

option.name: --rfc3164
tip: Use the obsolete BSD syslog protocol.

option.name: --rfc5424
tip: Use the syslog protocol (the default for remote).
<snip> can be notime, notq, and/or nohost.

option.name: --sd-id
tip: RFC 5424 structured data ID.

option.name: --sd-param
tip: RFC 5424 structured data name=value.

option.name: --server
tip: Write to this remote syslog server.

option.name: --size
tip: Maximum size for a single message.

option.name: --socket
tip: Write to this Unix socket.

option.name: --socket-errors
tip: Print connection errors when using Unix sockets.
Possible values: on, off, auto

option.name: --stderr
tip: Output message to standard error as well.

option.name: --tag
tip: Mark every line with this tag.

option.name: --tcp
tip: Use TCP only.

option.name: --udp
tip: Use UDP only.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version.

option.name: -i
tip: Log the logger command's PID.
